methodology.api: Client-observed loopback HTTP time through full response body, persistent Node fetch connections, no retries, sequential warm runs.
methodology.dashboard: Chromium navigation to employee dashboard until application, stats and anomaly responses finish and program/statistics render; existing session and warm browser cache. Excludes human interaction and decorative animation duration.
methodology.submission: Final submit endpoint only; distinct pre-created drafts with one actual PDF evidence file each, upload/preparation outside timed interval.
methodology.report: Administrator applications CSV export, complete bytes received; includes server export audit write.
methodology.environment: Release API binary in Development environment; Next.js production server. Isolated snapshot of local PostgreSQL database. Not a load/stress/cold-start benchmark.

sourceRevision: Dated uncommitted local working copy based on c750306; predates subsequent tab-session and live-eligibility fixes.
frameworkAtMeasurement: Next.js 16.4.3; predates the current 16.4.6 security patch.
